title: Whole Counsel of God
definition: The whole counsel of God is the full scope of biblical truth God has revealed, not merely selected passages or favorite themes.
summary: Faithful teaching receives and proclaims the fullness of what God has spoken.
christFocus: Jesus is the center of the whole counsel of God, and all biblical truth finds its proper place under His lordship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The whole counsel of God guards the Church from selective Christianity. God's people need Scripture's comfort, warnings, commands, promises, doctrine, history, wisdom, and Gospel proclamation.

Faithful ministry does not only emphasize favorite truths. It teaches the breadth of Scripture so believers are formed by everything God has revealed.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: When believers only hear selected themes, they can become unbalanced, shallow, or vulnerable to error. The whole counsel of God matters because partial truth can still produce distorted discipleship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not only study the parts of Scripture that are easiest or most familiar. Let God teach, correct, comfort, and challenge you through the full range of His Word.
